targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_date AS time, direction, sum(row_count) AS rows
FROM smf.stats_dataset_daily
WHERE event_date >= today() - 10
GROUP BY event_date, direction
ORDER BY time

SELECT event_date AS time, direction, sum(excp_sum) AS excp
FROM smf.stats_dataset_daily
WHERE event_date >= today() - 10
GROUP BY event_date, direction
ORDER BY time

SELECT direction, job_name, dsname, sum(row_count) AS rows, sum(excp_sum) AS excp
FROM smf.stats_dataset_daily
WHERE event_date >= today() - 10
GROUP BY direction, job_name, dsname
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT event_date, smf_system_id, job_name, dsname, volume_serial, count() AS rows
FROM smf.smf_17
WHERE event_date >= today() - 10
GROUP BY event_date, smf_system_id, job_name, dsname, volume_serial
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 100
